title: Workspace layout configuration schema
description: Validation schema for conf/workspace.conf.yaml: the structural blueprint of the workspace. A recursive tree of two dedicated node types: `artifactNode` (a file bound to an `artifact` schema slug + `template` slug and a required `cardinality`) and `folderNode` (a container of `children`, no schema/template/required cardinality of its own). Every node's `slug` is its OWN path segment only — the full workspace-relative path is deduced by concatenating ancestor slugs top-down; a `slug` may embed `<name>` VARIABLE placeholders (e.g. `<epic-slug>`), optionally mixed with literal text (e.g. `<epic-slug>.epic.md`), and the same variable name may recur across a node and its descendants. Artifact-to-artifact derivation constraints (which kinds a given artifact may declare as sources) live in the artifact schemas themselves — the node's `artifact` binding is the join point.

artifactNode.description: An artifact (file) node: a leaf that binds its own path segment (`slug`) to an artifact schema (`artifact`) and template (`template`), with a required `cardinality`. Never has `children` — artifacts are files, not folders.

slug.description: This artifact file's own path segment (not the full path: ancestors contribute their own segments).

cardinality.description: How many instances of this artifact may exist at this position.

artifact.description: The artifact kind that validates this node's file, identified by its schema slug (the centralized `artifactSlug`).

template.description: The artifact template that seeds this node's file, identified by its template slug.

folderNode.description: A folder node: a container of `children`, with no schema, template, or required cardinality of its own — only `slug` and `description` are required.

slug.description: This folder's own path segment (not the full path: ancestors contribute their own segments).

children.description: Child nodes nested under this folder.
